headline: Flagler pull clear as North Georgia draw again
dek: Flagler won at USC Aiken to make it three conference wins from three, while North Georgia drew again, at Clayton State. Neither side has lost this season, and Flagler's only dropped points are three draws outside the conference.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: North Georgia's eighteen goals are more than USC Aiken and Lander have scored between them, and nine different players have shared them.

wire.line: Every side but Flagler has now dropped points inside the conference; USC Aiken are the only one without any.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches have passed their date with no published result, among them Clayton State's visit to Oglethorpe and Middle Georgia State's to Columbia on 22 August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Isaac Calderon has scored seven of North Georgia's eighteen goals from twenty-four shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Javier Gongora Andres has scored six of Middle Georgia State's thirteen goals from twenty-three shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Theo Hoang has scored six of Georgia Southwestern's nine goals from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ryan Rivas has conceded three times in Flagler's goal this season.

last_match.line: Flagler have still not lost this season; USC Aiken have lost both of their conference matches.

next_match.line: The only two unbeaten sides meet; Flagler have won every conference match and North Georgia have drawn two of theirs.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
